title: Certificate revocation body
description: A certificate withdrawn (academy.md 3, AC-17, register row DK25). Signed by the Registrar, by a Court (the Courts institution account), or by the Clinic on drift. The certificate must exist and not already be revoked. A revocation for cheating, a ruling or drift also sends the holder's tier back to where it was before the promotion that rested on the certificate. Chain: none (prev is null).

evidence.description: What the revocation rests on: a ruling id, a Clinic finding, or the facts.

article.description: The Article of the Code, where one applies.
